# DeedHound

> Sheriff Sales & Foreclosure Auctions. Free, unofficial lists of upcoming sheriff sales and foreclosure auctions compiled daily from lists published by county sheriffs and Kentucky master commissioners. Always verify with the official county source before bidding; not legal or financial advice.

## States

- [Ohio sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/ohio/): 218 upcoming sales in 27 counties, data as of Nov 8, 2026 6:03 AM ET or later
- [Pennsylvania sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/pennsylvania/): 1756 upcoming sales in 3 counties, data as of Nov 10, 2026 6:46 AM ET or later
- [Kentucky sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/kentucky/): 76 upcoming sales in 2 counties, data as of Nov 10, 2026 7:01 AM ET or later
- [New Jersey sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/new-jersey/): 1268 upcoming sales in 17 counties, data as of Nov 4, 2026 1:59 PM ET or later

- [How Deal Check works](https://deedhound.app/deal-check/): how listings are graded Strong / Fair / Pass from published bids and official values
